tests.name: BASELINE
tests.instruction: Sit normally in front of the camera and look generally forward.

tests.name: NORMAL_READING_WRITING
tests.instruction: Read or write naturally for about 30 seconds. Looking slightly down at desk allowed.

tests.name: CLEAR_TURN_LEFT
tests.instruction: Turn your head clearly to the LEFT and hold naturally for about 5 seconds, then face forward.

tests.name: CLEAR_TURN_RIGHT
tests.instruction: Turn your head clearly to the RIGHT and hold naturally for about 5 seconds, then face forward.

tests.name: HEAD_REST_SLEEP
tests.instruction: Rest your head clearly on the desk or arms in a sleep/rest posture for about 5-8 seconds, then sit upright.

tests.name: STANDING
tests.instruction: Stand up clearly while remaining visible for about 8 seconds, then sit.

tests.name: PHONE
tests.instruction: Hold a normal mobile phone clearly visible near your torso/desk for about 10 seconds.

tests.name: LEAVE_AND_RETURN
tests.instruction: Leave the camera frame completely for about 8 seconds, then return.

tests.name: PARTIAL_OCCLUSION
tests.instruction: Partially cover your face/head with a hand or turn so face becomes hard to resolve for 5 seconds.

tests.name: DISTANCE_SCALE
tests.instruction: Move farther from the camera while remaining visible, then move closer.

tests.name: TWO_PERSON
tests.instruction: Optional: second volunteer sits in frame to test multi-student tracking and association.
